processing: Measure paired medians, wins and95% intervals against each control; distinguish an established latency improvement from useful instruction/size gains. No change to the Mech algorithm.
whole_process: Report all whole-process results; no mandatory whole-process acceptance gate, per explicit user instruction.
instructions: Report native code/stack, retired instructions/cycles and their changes against identical-baseline controls. Lower instruction counts alone do not prove lower latency.
memory: Require exact scalar/DEFLATE semantic/allocation rows; report full heap, allocations, RSS/footprint and size.
correctness: All415 actual native contract names,7 new upstream native checks,3 retained mask checks,35 related output fixtures and133 exact scalar/DEFLATE rows.
source_experiments: Three source variants specialize checked four/five-tag rows for triple generation, quartet generation, and their combination. Original loops retained for every other width. No change to JSON input, scoring or Rust oracle.
confirmation: A promising source winner requires an independent frozen comparison; retain every initial and contrary source result. No unchanged retry for a failed candidate.
